create.name: Istituto Lama Tzong Khapa
create.bio:
The Istituto Lama Tzong Khapa is a Tibetan Buddhist study and retreat centre at Pomaia, in the hills of the Pisa province in Tuscany, housed in a nineteenth-century castle and its park. It belongs to the FPMT network founded by Lama Thubten Yeshe and Lama Thubten Zopa Rinpoche, and was one of its first centres: three Italian students of the two lamas set it up in Milan in 1976, and it moved to the castle the following year. It takes its name from Lama Tsongkhapa, founder of the Gelug school, and the Dalai Lama has visited it several times.

The institute is known for long study programmes taught in Italian and English, above all the multi-year FPMT Basic Program, led by its resident teacher Geshe Tenphel, a Geshe Lharampa from Sera Je who has taught there since 1998. Alongside these it runs weekend teachings with its resident geshes, introductory courses on Buddhism and meditation, visiting teachers and community pujas, most of them offered for a suggested donation and many streamed for members. Its YouTube channel, running since 2010, carries festival talks, ceremonies, programme introductions and short interviews with its teachers.

courses.title: FPMT Basic Program 2027 – 2030
courses.description: A multi-year course in Tibetan Buddhist philosophy and meditation, with weekday teachings, review classes and discussion groups, taken residentially or online, in Italian or English. Single modules can also be joined.

courses.title: Buddhismo per tutti, piccoli passi per una vita più felice
courses.description: An introductory weekend with Geshe Tenphel on the basic ideas of Buddhism and how they apply to daily life, open to complete beginners, in person or by stream for members.
courses.price: non è richiesta una quota di partecipazione ma è consigliato fare un’offerta (suggerito 60 euro)

courses.title: Insegnamenti con Robina Courtin
courses.description: Several days of teachings by Ven. Robina Courtin on dependent arising and emptiness in Lama Tsongkhapa's writings, given in English with simultaneous Italian translation.
courses.price: non è richiesta una quota di partecipazione fissa, ma è consigliato fare un’offerta (suggerito 120 euro)

free_resources.title: MP Talks
free_resources.description: A series of free online talks by experienced teachers, each exploring one key theme from the institute's Masters Program, such as bodhichitta or the four noble truths.

free_resources.title: Insegnamenti con i Ghesce
free_resources.description: Weekend Dharma teachings with the institute's resident geshes, including a series on the mind-training text The Wheel of Sharp Weapons, open to everyone.
